qualification.education_qualification: Graduate in Civil Engineering or equivalent, Postgraduate (ME/M Tech)
qualification.details: Senior Pavement Design cum Material Expert: Essential: Graduate in Civil Engineering or equivalent from a recognized University/Institute. Desirable: Postgraduate (ME/M Tech) in Highway/ Pavement or other related field from a recognized University/Institute. Desirable: PhD in Pavement/Highway engineering or other related field. Experience: Minimum 20 years of overall professional experience in highway projects. Hand-on experience in Pavement Design and in life cycle costing under IRC 37/IRC 58, and other international codes and Design Software. Implementation of performance-graded binders/ modified bitumen, recycling technologies and innovative pavement technologies such as Geosynthetics, WMA etc. Experience in pavement forensic investigation and failure analysis specifically in pavement design, construction, quality assurance, maintenance and pavement management. Quantity Surveyor (QS): Essential: Graduate in Civil Engineering or equivalent / Certificate course from 'Institution of Quantity Surveying'. Experience: Minimum 08 years' Experience in Quantity estimation, Preparation of Bill of Quantities, rate analysis, Payment Schedules of Contract Documents for National Highways or major highway projects involving major bridges / structures /tunnels.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NHAI recruitment is 28 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the NHAI recruitment, for the posts of Senior Pavement Design cum Material Expert and Quantity Surveyor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Senior Pavement Design cum Material Expert?
faq.answer: For the Senior Pavement Design cum Material Expert post, candidates need to be a Graduate in Civil Engineering or equivalent. A Postgraduate degree in Highway/Pavement or a related field is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Quantity Surveyor post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Quantity Surveyor post is 45 years. The age relaxation rules may apply as per the discretion of the Chairman.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Pavement Design cum Material Expert position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Pavement Design cum Material Expert position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 5,00,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these NHAI posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these NHAI posts will be conducted by a committee through interviews.

faq.question: Q8. What is the minimum experience required for the Quantity Surveyor role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 8 years of experience is required for the Quantity Surveyor role, specifically in quantity estimation and related tasks for national highways or major projects.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications for NHAI Recruitment 2026 are to be submitted strictly online through the official website. Offline applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
